name: homebridge-doorman.mobi
description: Homebridge accessory for buzzers controlled by doorman.mobi

apiUrl.title: Doorman API URL
apiUrl.description: The Doorman API base URL, such as https://szpala.com/api.

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: A Doorman bearer token. Use this or an email and password.

email.title: Email
email.description: Used to obtain a Doorman session when accessToken is not set.

password.title: Password
password.description: Used with email to obtain a Doorman session when accessToken is not set.
